QuestInfo.name: Suspicious Expression
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052121# says acting is all about observing others and impersonating them. She wants you to go to #b#m100000000##k and observe #b#p1012003##k so you can copy his expressions...
QuestInfo.2: You learned a suspicious expression from observing #p1012003#.

0.0: Acting is easy! All you need to do is learn a bunch of different facial expressions. However, there are so many different kinds of expressions, and it's not easy to change your face just like that.
0.1: But, the answer is simple. Just observe people with the expression you want and copy them. Understand?

yes.0: Acting lesson the first: Go to #b#m100000000##k and copy #b#p1012003##k's expression. You'll then be able to make his expression whenever you want.

no.0: Why come to class if you're not going to take it seriously?

npc.0: Did you go see #b#p1012003##k yet? He's in #b#m100000000##k.
